idea-plugin.name: Conda License Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds every environment.yml and .condarc line that pulls from Anaconda's licensed repository

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Conda License Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 8 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/conda-channel-license-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/conda-channel-license-lint

action.text: Conda License Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Conda License Lint on the file in the editor
